items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Yeah, they had Carter and Poe Gibson.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear many minstrel shows or other traveling tent shows that would come around? Or did you ever work with any of those? There were a lot of...

Well, I never did care too much for working on the shows, but I had a lot of friends that did work on them. I remember Georgia Smart Set, Silas Green, and also the Georgia Minister, Rabbit Foot. That was the one Jalee Davis was on, Sweet Papa Snowball they call it, he was on Rabbit Foot. That's through the running, I think. Yeah, they had Carter and Poe Gibson. And then, uh, Holkamp, he had, uh, Georgia Smart Set. Yeah. I had a lot of boys. I, uh, I, uh, organized a band with some of the boys out of that, when…
Did those shows, uh, just travel mostly in the summertime and what they do in the winters?
